en.headline: 72-year-old hiker found dead on Sha Tin trail after three-day search
en.dek: Rescuers located the body of Tam Hing-man on a mountain path in Man Hang, Fo Tan, on Tuesday morning; he had gone missing while hiking on Saturday.
body: A 72-year-old man who went missing while hiking in the Sha Tin area has been found dead after a three-day search involving multiple emergency services.

Police said the family of Tam Hing-man reported him missing on Saturday after losing contact. He had left home in Tai Wai that morning and set off with friends from Fo Tan, becoming separated near Kwai Tei New Village. Family members briefly reached him by phone that evening; he said he was descending and nearing Wong Chuk Yeung Village before contact was lost, reportedly after his phone battery ran out.

Police, firefighters, the Government Flying Service and the Civil Aid Service conducted a prolonged search. At about 11.30am on Tuesday, rescuers found a man collapsed on a mountain trail in Man Hang, Fo Tan. He was certified dead at the scene. Police said the man was understood to be the missing 72-year-old. The cause of death will be determined by a postmortem examination.

zh.headline: 72歲行山客沙田失蹤三日後尋回遺體
zh.dek: 搜救人員周二上午在火炭蚊坑山路發現譚姓男子倒卧，當場證實死亡；他周六行山時與同伴走失後失聯。
body: 一名72歲男子在沙田一帶行山失蹤三日後，搜救人員於周二尋回其遺體。
警方表示，譚興文的家人周六報案指失去聯絡。譚男當日早上由大圍住所出發，與友人由火炭結伴上山，途經上桂地新村附近時與隊員走失。家人當晚一度接通電話，譚男稱正在下山，快到黃竹洋村，其後疑因手機沒電而再無音訊。
警方、消防處、飛行服務隊及民安隊連日搜救。周二上午約11時30分，人員在火炭蚊坑一山路發現一名男子倒卧，當場證實死亡。警方指死者相信即是失蹤的72歲譚姓男子，死因有待驗屍後確定。
